of the Ca2+ regulation system. Here, we
Using NeuroRD [5], we built a reaction-diffusion model of calcium (Ca) dynamics (A) in a 21 μm long dendrite
(1.2 μm diameter) of a CA1 pyramidal neuron with a single dendritic spine (with and without the SA) in the middle.
Ca2+ regulation included extrusion pumps (PMCA and NCX) and Ca2+ internal buffers (calbindin, calmodulin, fixed buffer).
The ER model contained SarcoEndoplasmic Reticulum Ca2+ ATPase type 2 and 3 (SERCA pump), RyR2s
(in the dendrite), RyR3s (in the spine neck), and Ca2+ buffering in the ER. The model also contained mGluR5
activation by glutamate (Glu), IP3 production and IP3R1 activation. The RyR2/RyR3 model accounted for
inhibition/activation by calmodulin and was fitted to experimental data [6,7,8]. We simulated synaptic activation
as CA2+ and Glu input to the PSD and VGCC activation as Ca2+ input to the dendritic membrane.
